scope.clock_grouping: The ungrouped window counts keep the least-name first-return convention and j = 0 or 1. The opportunity counts are before testing eligibility of any second part.
scope.counting_units: The 88,299 rows count tests once. Numbering counts weight each order once, including orders that produce the same named start. Swap counts count each law and start case once.
scope.run_4: The verdict recount uses recorded own births by round, first trace differences and reached rounds. The stored fields do not contain the complete growth or course required to derive those inputs.
scope.run_5_and_6: Each numbered start is reconstructed from the frozen stars. Survival is the presence of a supporting test in the retained listing, with undisclosed tests represented by stored tallies.
